facts.fact: Podbean says advertisers can set budget caps and modify or stop a campaign at any time.

facts.fact: Podbean states that its programmatic podcast ads can be served only to listeners in a chosen state or metro area.
facts.quote: So, for example, you can run ads to be served up only to listeners in your state or metro area.
